examples.arabic: ليلى نامت وهي بتحلم بألعابها الجديدة اللي هتاخدها بكره.
examples.english: Layla slept while she was dreaming of her new toys that she would get tomorrow.
examples.transliteration: Layla namet we heya bete7lam be al3abha el gedida elly hatakhodha bokra.

examples.arabic: مصطفى: ماشي يا يوسف، أشوفك بكرة!
examples.english: Mostafa: Okay, Youssef, see you tomorrow!
examples.transliteration: Mostafa: Mashi ya Youssef, ashoofak bokra!

examples.arabic: بكرة هنروح أنا وأختي السوق علشان نشتري فاكهة طازة، ممكن نجيب أربع برتقالات كبار.
examples.english: Tomorrow, my sister and I will go to the market to buy fresh fruit; we might get four big oranges.
examples.transliteration: Bokra hanrooḥ ana we ʾokhty el sooʾ ʾalashan neshtry fakha taza, momken nigeeb ʾarbaʾ bortoqalat kobar.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: في الاخر اتفقنا نشرب شاي مع بعض بكره
examples.english: In the end, we agreed to drink tea together tomorrow.
examples.transliteration: fi el akher etafakna neshrab shay maa baad bokra

examples.arabic: دلوقتي احنا هنذاكر عشان الامتحان بكره
examples.english: Now we will study for the exam tomorrow
examples.transliteration: delwaety ehna hanezaker ashan el emtehan bokra

examples.arabic: فرح اختي بكرة واحنا مبسوطين اوي
examples.english: My sister's wedding is tomorrow and we are very happy.
examples.transliteration: farah okhty bokra we ehna mabsoteen awy
